subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI normalize provider aliases to canonical ids in all Usage/Sessions display and aggregate paths, and if so should it also show the original alias as secondary context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing display labels plus aggregate/cache/export keys is a product/API choice that affects how users reconcile UI data with their config files.

options.title: Canonical with alias context
options.body: Normalize provider ids for matching, aggregation, export, and primary display, while showing the configured alias in a tooltip or secondary label when it differs.

options.title: Canonical only
options.body: Show and export only canonical provider ids, accepting that users may need docs or migration help to map old aliases back to config values.

options.title: Preserve raw display
options.body: Leave raw aliases visible and only fix narrower matching/deduplication bugs, accepting the reported UI/internal inconsistency.

recommendation.title: Canonical with alias context
recommendation.body: Normalize provider ids for matching, aggregation, export, and primary display, while showing the configured alias in a tooltip or secondary label when it differs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main owner signal for the affected UI usage and gateway usage paths and is best placed to decide the display/aggregation boundary.
